The treasury can allocate 70 rounds of production inputs, plus 40 grain/6 parts for freight. Arrival takes 600 seconds; one shipment at a time, using the destination's public capacity. Export settlement bookings last up to 1800 seconds and take priority once earlier goods arrive and free capacity. The creditor clears the balance upon receiving the goods; if they are returned en route, the original debt is restored. Switching to purchases using only your own balance avoids adding new debt, but does not forgive existing debt.
